text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hmm hum hum, hmm hmm hum~♪
choice_data_list: Good morning. It's rare to hear you humming.
Good morning. It's rare to hear you humming.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyawaa! T-Trainer!?
Th-This was just me getting caught up in nostalgia, or rather...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I happened to run into Opera O-san
at the park yesterday..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To think that I was actually able to watch
the five-hour special edition of 'Descent of the Overlord Opera'~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Remembering that singing voice gives me courage.
I feel like I can get through today without messing up~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looks like you had a very fulfilling day off!
